project.name: SCRIPE — Full-Stack Sports Operations OS (Backend .NET 10 + Frontend Next.js 16)
project.description: Unified Full-Stack Knowledge Graph uniting all 16,242 Backend nodes (18 Modules) and 9,269 Frontend nodes (Next.js 16 MVVM & @core/ui/*) with cross-stack HTTP API bridges.

nodes.name: AstraFlow v2.2.0 Flagship Framework
nodes.summary: In-house 15-package .NET 10 framework providing high-throughput CQRS mediation (AstraFlow.Mediator), contracts (AstraFlow.Contracts), compile-time mapping ([AstraGenerateMapping]), security redaction, and OpenTelemetry diagnostics.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: AstraFlow 6-Stage Security-Critical Mediator Pipeline
nodes.summary: Strict pre-handler pipeline order in Core.Application: 1. LoggingBehavior -> 2. ValidationBehavior -> 3. FeatureCheckBehavior -> 4. FieldRestrictionEnforcementBehavior -> 5. WebhookDispatchBehavior -> 6. CachingBehavior + IdempotencyBehavior.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: Result<T> Pattern (Zero Business Exceptions)
nodes.summary: Every command and query handler returns Result<T> or Result with typed Error codes rather than throwing exceptions for domain or validation failures.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: 3-Project Clean Architecture Module Boundary
nodes.summary: Every backend module is strictly isolated into {Module}.Domain (zero external deps), {Module}.Application (CQRS & contracts), and {Module}.Infrastructure (EF Core DbContext, repositories, jobs, seeders).
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: Dual-Mode Enterprise Persistence (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
nodes.summary: Supports Single Physical DB with isolated module schemas (identity.*, venue.*, crm.*, finance.*) AND Per-Module Physical DBs with zero code refactoring across 3 database engines.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: Per-Module Transactional Outbox/Inbox & Sequential Notifications
nodes.summary: Every module migrates its own outbox_messages and inbox_messages tables and publishes in-scope domain notifications sequentially to prevent DbContext concurrency races.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: 5-Layer Security Defense & PBAC (RBAC + GBAC + ABAC)
nodes.summary: Concentric security architecture: L1 Cloudflare/RateLimits/CORS, L2 15m JWT + 30d httpOnly Refresh Cookies + 2FA, L3 PBAC (Role + Group + Attribute), L4 TenantId Filters + AES-GCM, L5 Immutable Audit Logs.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: Bidirectional Field-Level Security (FLS)
nodes.summary: Enforces read and write field restrictions across all modules via FieldRestrictionEnforcementBehavior (write gate), FieldProjectionMiddleware (response stripping), and Identity <-> CustomFields mutual guards.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: SecureId Codec Boundary Encryption
nodes.summary: Encrypts internal GUID primary and foreign keys into opaque URL-safe tokens across all API DTOs via ScripeSecureIdCodec and AstraFlow value resolvers.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: Media Owner-Pair Tenant Isolation Fence
nodes.summary: Prevents cross-tenant or cross-record file attachment in CustomFields via IMediaFileOwnershipReader and gates all private file downloads through tenant-filtered CanAccessFileQuery.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: Fail-Closed Server-Role Startup DI Guards
nodes.summary: ModuleRegistration.cs validates cross-module contract dependencies at startup (Identity<->CustomFields->Media, Finance->CatalogPricing->Venue->PartyKernel+OrganizationCore, CRM->PartyKernel) so misconfigured server roles fail loud before serving traffic.
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

nodes.name: 11-Point UAT Readiness & Idempotent Seeding Protocol
nodes.summary: Mandates IModulePermissionProvider, IModuleFeatureProvider (editions & quotas), IModuleMenuProvider (bilingual EN/AR menus), IModuleSeeder (production baseline), and IModuleDevDataSeeder (rich dev personas).
nodes.languageNotes: SCRIPE Backend Component (concept): Adheres to the 3-project module boundary (Domain, Application, Infrastructure), UTC DateTime discipline, and 5-Layer PBAC security.

tour.title: [Backend 1] Host.API Entry Point & 8-Phase Bootstrap (Program.cs)
tour.languageLesson: ASP.NET Core 10 Minimal Hosting Model: Uses WebApplicationBuilder to compose all 18 modules through deterministic extension methods while keeping module internals isolated.

tour.title: [Backend 2] Core SharedKernel, AuditableEntity & Result<T> Monad
tour.languageLesson: Functional Error Handling in C# 13: Returning Result<T> instead of throwing exceptions eliminates stack-unwinding overhead and makes every failure path explicit in the type signature.

tour.title: [Backend 3] AstraFlow 2.2.0 Pipeline, Compile-Time Mappers & Dual-Mode DB
tour.description:
**Architectural Role:** SCRIPE runs 100% on the in-house **AstraFlow 2.2.0** framework family and **Dual-Mode Multi-Database Persistence**.

- **Mediator Pipeline:** `UnhandledExceptionBehavior` → `LoggingBehavior` → `PerformanceBehavior` → `ValidationBehavior` → `TransactionBehavior`.
- **Compile-Time Mapping:** `[AstraGenerateMapping]` generates zero-allocation static partial `ToDto()` methods at compile time.
- **Dual-Mode Persistence:** Supports Single-DB (18 isolated schemas) or Multi-DB across **SQL Server**, **PostgreSQL**, and **Oracle**.
tour.languageLesson: Roslyn Incremental Source Generation: [AstraGenerateMapping] emits static C# extension methods during compilation, achieving 0-allocation DTO projection without runtime reflection.
